name: expo-queen-lace-leather-girl
image_purpose: Convention outfit post and fashion moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic fashion portrait of an approved adult woman posing confidently in a busy convention or expo hall.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, clear-framed glasses, chandelier earrings, and long black gloves. Preserve the black lace-and-leather-inspired fashion outfit, opaque structured coverage, decorative lace panels, bead accents, and black thigh-high platform boots without adding sexualized emphasis.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical portrait with the subject centered, one hand on her hip and the other relaxed, legs in a poised confident stance. Include a blurred convention crowd, vendor booths, fabric-covered tables, banners without invented text, polished concrete, and a high industrial ceiling with rows of lights.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused overhead convention lighting, subtle reflections on the polished floor and glossy boots, shallow depth of field, busy but blurred expo atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm fashion-documentary look, full-body vertical framing, realistic skin texture, detailed lace, faux leather, metal bead and floor texture, subtle film grain, natural vignetting, restrained saturation.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-realistic full-body vertical fashion photograph of one approved adult woman with long dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, clear-framed glasses, chandelier earrings, and long black gloves, posing confidently at the center of a large indoor convention or expo hall. She wears an elaborate black lace-and-leather-inspired fashion outfit with opaque structured coverage, decorative lace panels, bead accents, and black thigh-high platform boots. One hand rests on her hip and the other hangs relaxed. Blurred attendees, vendor booths, cloth-covered tables, banners without readable invented text, polished concrete floor, high industrial ceiling, and rows of overhead lights fill the background. Soft diffused artificial light, subtle floor reflections, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, and a polished dramatic fashion-documentary mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, lingerie emphasis, sexualized pose, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, extra fingers, deformed, invented logos, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur

Any replacement person must be an approved adult and retain the same fashion intent and environment continuity.
